coords: normalised 0-1, origin top-left of the frame
note: explode.frames[j].anchors are the 2D anchor points of each labelled part in explode frame j; labels are meant to be shown on the last (fully exploded) frame. rotate anchors are informational (visible=false means occluded at that angle).

parts.name: Heat-Spreader Label
parts.description: The printed sticker on top of the chips. Its foil backing spreads heat from the flash and controller across the drive.

parts.name: NAND Flash
parts.description: The memory chips that store your data. They keep it with the power off, and together hold the full 1 TB.

parts.name: SSD Controller
parts.description: The drive's processor: it talks NVMe to the PC, spreads writes evenly across the flash and corrects errors.

parts.name: PCB
parts.description: The circuit board (22 × 80 mm, hence "2280") whose copper traces connect the chips to the connector.

parts.name: Mounting Notch
parts.description: The half-round cut-out where a single screw or latch holds the drive flat against the motherboard.

parts.name: M.2 M-Key Connector
parts.description: The gold edge contacts that plug into the M.2 slot. The M-key gap marks a PCIe x4 slot, which NVMe drives use.
